use_case: Research and due diligence: ask once, verify everywhere (harder version)

release.label: Alphabet Q3 2026 earnings release, Exhibit 99.1 (copy with 2 planted conflicts)

call.label: Alphabet Q3 2026 earnings call, prepared remarks (video, no transcript)

grading.value: within 0.5% of the answer, or abs_tol in the question's unit; the trap is correct only if null with no citations
grading.citation: document quote must appear verbatim in the cited source (whitespace, table pipes, $ and quote styles ignored) and contain one anchor set for that source; call timestamp within call_tol_s of where the figure is spoken (reference: data/part2/call_reference)
grading.coverage: each group in 'required' needs at least one verified citation from a source in that group; questions with required_figures also need one figure set to appear across the verified quotes
grading.conflict: flag must be true exactly for the planted questions, and the release must be cited with its planted value
grading.fully_verified: value, every citation, coverage and conflict all pass

questions.question: Google Services revenue growth year over year for the quarter, in percent
Free cash flow for the trailing twelve months ended September 30, 2026, in USD billions

planted.note: TTM column of the free-cash-flow table changed from 19,747 to 17,947; the 10-Qs do not report free cash flow, so only the call contradicts it

Increase in Google Cloud revenue backlog from June 30, 2026 to September 30, 2026, in USD billions

Capital expenditures for the first half of 2026 (six months ended June 30, 2026), in USD billions

questions.question: Capital expenditures (purchases of property and equipment) in Q3 2026, in USD billions
questions.lookalike: cost of revenues was also $51.4 billion

Total net proceeds from at-the-market issuance of Class A and Class C stock in Q3 2026, in USD billions
questions.note: either both components ($4.3B + $8.1B, may be split across quotes) or the cash-flow line 'Proceeds from issuance of common stock, net of costs' (12,371)

Share of the revenue backlog expected to be recognized as revenue over the next 24 months, in percent
Low end of the full-year 2026 capital expenditures guidance range, in USD billions
Implied Q4 2026 capital expenditures if full-year 2026 capex lands at the midpoint of the guidance range, in USD billions
Consolidated revenue guidance for Q4 2026, in USD billions

grading_changes.change: accept rounded prose forms that appear verbatim in the same filing (e.g. '$125.1 billion' for 125,102; '$80.6 billion' for 80,598; '$132.0 billion' for 131,953), and let the two ATM components be cited in separate quotes or via the cash-flow proceeds line
grading_changes.why: the pilot rejected verbatim, correct citations only because they used the filing's prose wording instead of the table figure
